source: Frequently Occurring Surnames from the 2000 Census

note: The 2000 file, alongside the 2010 one. A decade apart matters more for genealogy than it sounds: a surname borne by a hundred people in 2000 and ninety-nine in 2010 drops out of the later list entirely, and those vanishing names are exactly the ones a researcher is chasing.
